about: Every outside source the tracker relies on, and every claim the public site makes or plans to make, with how it is backed. Status values. Sources: live-data (our code reads it directly), checked (opened and the specific fact confirmed, with date), cited (from docs/research, not re-opened for this use), rejected (tested or considered and not used). Claims: measured (our own test, see evidence), sourced (backed by a checked source), unverified (needs a source before it is published), to-confirm (Philip must confirm). Rule: add a source here the moment research uses it. Nothing marked unverified or to-confirm goes on the public site.
